criteria.notes: The agenda preserves current-event emphasis, chronological upcoming events, calendar normalization, live progress, and all-day states.
No external visual reference was declared; the agent-authored venue-programme brief is the review authority.
An editorial current-event field paired with a continuous chronological rail gives the agenda a venue-specific identity.
Primary hierarchy and operational values remain legible at each rendered signage distance and target ratio.
Every rendered preset and state was inspected; text, status, and surface contrast remain readable after theme changes.
Long, compact, wrapped, and descender-bearing labels show complete ink or deliberate ellipsis with no partial lines.
Content fills the declared surface intentionally across fixed and adaptive ratios without overlap or accidental dead space.
Dark and light themes coordinate feature, timeline, progress, and empty-state treatments without external assets.
Compared with all nine other maintained examples; composition, pagination, hierarchy, and visual language remain distinct.
